name: Fujicolor ETERNA Vivid 160
notes: Fujifilm brochure (English, 'FUJICOLOR NEGATIVE FILM ETERNA Vivid 160', 35 mm Type 8543 / 16 mm Type 8643), page 1 plots; reference KB-0701E (SK・07・03・F1120・F9711), (c) 2007. Motion-picture negative. Exposure index 160 under 3200 K tungsten; 100 in daylight with Fuji LBA-12 or Kodak No.85 filter (balance given here is the tungsten one the curves were exposed with). Processing is ECN-2 (the plots say 'specified standard conditions').

Characteristic curves: exposure 3200 K light source for 1/50 second with Fuji Filter SC-41, Status M densities. The x axis is printed in CAMERA STOPS (-7 to +7, no absolute lux-seconds): the calibration here multiplies stops by 0.30103, so x is RELATIVE log10 exposure with 0 at the printed 0.0 stop (not an absolute log H). The curves are drawn from about -6.5 to +6.0 stops (log10 -1.96 to 1.81). b/g/r are the blue, green and red vector curves. The y axis printed 0.0-3.0; the grid lines of the plot are slightly irregular and the frame edges lie a little beyond 0.0 and 3.0, so only the interior grid lines (0.5-2.0) were used for the y calibration.

Spectral sensitivity: y is 'Relative spectral sensitivity (log)' with a printed axis 0.0-3.0 (read here as printed, calibrated on the 1.0 and 2.0 grid lines); sensitivity is the reciprocal of exposure (ergs/cm2) required to produce the specified density, 0.40 above minimum density, 'Arbitrary three color densities'. b about 385-518 nm (peak 2.2 at about 475 nm), g about 480-599 nm, r about 570-663 nm; each curve ends in near-vertical drops, so the last few nm are approximated on the 5 nm grid.

Spectral dye density plot has only 'mid' (typical densities for a mid-scale neutral subject, Status M three-colour densities) and 'min' (minimum densities, a dotted curve), no separate c/m/y dyes. The curves run about 405-695 nm; the vertical grid lines of the plot are slightly irregular (the 700 line sits about 2 pt beyond its even spacing), so only the 400/500/600 lines were used for the x calibration and the y axis uses the 0.5/1.0/1.5 interior grid lines.
Grain: RMS granularity 3.5 (1000 times the measured value, visual diffuse density 1.0 above minimum density, 48 um aperture). No log_h_ref or print stock is printed on the sheet.
log_h_ref: the curves are plotted against camera stops; 0 stops (normal exposure) is used as the reference exposure.
